details: Crypto exchange Bitget reported a $351.6 million security breach on September 24, 2026, involving unauthorized transfers from hot and warm wallets. Withdrawals were temporarily suspended, though the exchange stated user funds are safe and covered by a protection fund of over $464 million. The incident is under investigation, with a possible North Korean link being explored.
title: Crypto Exchange Bitget Suffers $351.6M Security Breach

details: Bitcoin dipped to around $84,000 and Ethereum to $2,674 on September 25, 2026, as rising U.S. Treasury yields and increased expectations for further Federal Reserve interest rate hikes pressured risk assets. The broader crypto market experienced a selloff, although BTC ETF inflows remained positive.
title: Bitcoin & Ethereum Retreat as Rate Hike Fears Sap Risk Appetite

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded significant net inflows, totaling $190.7 million on September 24, 2026, with week-to-date inflows exceeding $2.6 billion, marking the best week since October 2025. This indicates sustained institutional demand despite recent price corrections in the broader crypto market.
title: US Spot Bitcoin ETFs See Strong Inflows Despite Price Pullback

details: The tradable supply of Ethereum on crypto exchanges has fallen to a historic low of 3.49% of the total supply. This trend, with over 1.16% of ETH moving off exchanges since June, is primarily driven by increased staking and DeFi participation, suggesting reduced immediate selling pressure and potential for price appreciation.
title: Ethereum Exchange Supply Reaches Record Low, Signaling Reduced Selling Pressure

details: Solana's highly anticipated Alpenglow upgrade is scheduled for its mainnet launch on September 28. This upgrade aims to significantly reduce transaction finality from 12.8 seconds to 150 milliseconds and increase fault tolerance to 40%, potentially enhancing the network's performance and scalability. Solana ETFs have also seen 12 consecutive weeks of inflows.
title: Solana's Alpenglow Upgrade Set for September 28, Enhancing Speed

details: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) updated its FAQs on September 24, 2026, clarifying how registrants can engage with crypto assets and blockchain technology under the Commodity Exchange Act. The guidance confirms that futures commission merchants (FCMs) can use non-security crypto assets as margin and sets capital charges for proprietary positions in Bitcoin and Ethereum.
title: CFTC Updates FAQs for Crypto Assets and Blockchain Technologies

details: On September 25, 2026, a white-hat security researcher successfully rescued 23,155 NFTs, valued at nearly $6 million, from hundreds of wallets. This operation targeted a vulnerability in LimitBreak's Payment Processor V2 contract, which was flagged in relation to Magic Eden, highlighting ongoing security risks within the NFT ecosystem.
title: White-Hat Operation Rescues 23K NFTs from Payment Processor Exploit
